question: A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 15 g/cm³ . Its internal and external radii are 8 cm and 11 cm, respectively. What is the mass (in kg) of the shell ? (Take pi= (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mass = Volume × Density

Mass = (4/3) × π × (R³ − r³) × Density

Mass = (4/3) × (22/7) × (11³ − 8³) × 15 g

Mass = (88/21) × 819 × 15 = 88 × 39 × 15 = 51480 g

Mass in kg = 51480 ÷ 1000 = 51.48 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 51.48 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Density of the metal = 15 g/cm³

Internal radius (r) = 8 cm

External radius (R) = 11 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a hollow spherical shell = (4/3) × π × (R³ − r³)

Mass = Volume × Density

 
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 r = 8 cm
 R = 11 cm
 Hollow Spherical Shell Cross-Section

**Calculations:**

⇒ R³ = 11³ = 1331 cm³

⇒ r³ = 8³ = 512 cm³

⇒ R³ − r³ = 1331 − 512 = 819 cm³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 819

⇒ Volume = (88/21) × 819 = 88 × 39 = 3432 cm³

⇒ Mass in grams = 3432 × 15 = 51480 g

⇒ Mass in kg = 51480 ÷ 1000 = 51.48 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 51.48 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Solid Sphere

The total space occupied by a complete solid sphere is given by V = (4/3) × π × R³.

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a complete sphere is given by SA = 4 × π × R².

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a full sphere, so its volume is V = (2/3) × π × R³.
